description: Directed handoff graph. Each edge carries an artifact and a gate that MUST hold before the receiver may act. The gates are enforced in code by alpha_agent.agents_v2.pipeline; this file is the specification that code is tested against.

gates.agenda: the director has pre-registered the experiment and named its owning agent
gates.data_certified: data-foundation-agent certified the dataset PIT_SAFE with a known availability instant
gates.universe_defined: a point-in-time universe exists over a certified dataset, with its execution representation declared
gates.features_published: a versioned leak-safe feature set exists over a defined universe
gates.candidate_submitted: the owning signal agent recorded a measured HISTORICAL result under the frozen spec, sign and cost model
gates.skeptic_survived: validation-skeptic-agent passed the canonical statistical gate AND every adversarial check with a measured value
gates.risk_acceptable: risk-portfolio-agent accepted a skeptic survivor on portfolio risk
gates.final_tournament: the director ranks validated survivors against each other and against the estate's live candidates
gates.director_cleared: the director cleared one validated, meta-reviewed survivor; the research memory records QUALIFIED
gates.published: signal-publishing-agent wrote the research candidate artifact with safety labels
gates.governed_forward_request: the freeze and its adoption are performed by their canonical owners; the observation clock is today's prospective boundary or later
gates.escalation: unresolved dispute or exception routed to the director

bypass_rules: No edge leads from a signal agent to risk-portfolio-agent, meta-model-ensemble-agent, signal-publishing-agent or the director. The skeptic is the only door.
No edge leads from any agent to an operational owner (orders, fills, holdings, targets, proposals, capital eligibility).
An external canonical owner may appear only as the TARGET of governed_forward_request.
